definition: Two roommates share the same home-security service level Q. In a hypothetical decision model, their separate marginal dollar benefits are 80 − 2Q and 60 − Q, and each extra service unit costs $50.00. Both benefits remain positive. What Q equates combined marginal benefit with marginal cost?
explanation: Because both roommates benefit from the same service level, add marginal benefits: (80 − 2Q) + (60 − Q) = 50. Solving gives Q = (80 + 60 − 50)/3 = 30.00 service units.
